text:
claire-peopleops: Heads-up  Zoe (contractor) is converting to full-time and her official start is 9/1. We need a fresh I-9, benefits enrollment + payroll setup. BG vendor flagged a name discrepancy between her contractor record and new legal name.

dmitri-recruiter: She changed her last name last year and we updated GitHub and badge, but HR needs legal docs. Zoe prefers to start remote and keep her contractor laptop for a day or two. Any objections?

bg-check-bot: BG CHECK UPDATE: Zoe K. 2026005000 status: manual review. Note: name variation (previous contractor record: Zoe K. Smith). Requested docs: government ID showing current legal name and a legal name-change doc or marriage certificate.

claire-peopleops: Policy: Name-change docs required for payroll/legal identity alignment. For I-9 we need to see a current government ID (passport or DL) and complete a new I-9. Remote exception allowed if ID is provided within 3 business days or verified via authorized agent.

payroll: Also need SSN verification for payroll tax setup. If she used contractor 1099 previously, we might have a different TIN on record; please confirm SSN matches. We can't change tax withholding until the SSN is validated.

it-ops: For device: standard practice is to provision corporate laptop for FT on Day 0 and reclaim contractor device later. If People Ops wants Zoe to use contractor laptop for Day 1, we can ship a docking kit only and set a configuration hold. Alternatively, we can ship a fresh laptop but mark 'HOLD-ON-BG' so it sits at carrier until clearance. Which do you prefer?

claire-peopleops: Let's minimize churn: if Zoe can use her contractor laptop for first 48h, we ship docking station + headset. We'll hold full laptop until BG + SSN verify. That avoids immediate swap. Can IT do a quick audit on the contractor laptop (MDM, encryption) and confirm it's acceptable for FT use for 48h?

it-ops: Yes, IT can do remote audit + apply FT MDM profile over the wire. We'll schedule a short overlap session for Zoe to enroll the device and rotate keys. Requires Zoe to be available for a 15-min Zoom with IT before Day 1.

dmitri-recruiter: I'll ask Zoe about availability. Also note: benefits enrollment window opens Day 1 and she must enroll within 30 days or default elections apply. Can People Ops send benefits links once payroll confirms SSN?

newhire-zoe: Hi all 2026005550: thanks! I can do a 15-min IT session on 8/31 at 10am PT. I uploaded my passport and a scanned marriage certificate to the secure link earlier today: https://redwood-secure.upload/newhire/zoe. Are those the right docs? I used contractor TIN previously; my SSN is the same.

bg-check-bot: Docs received 2026005600. Manual reviewer notes: passport OK, marriage certificate received. Reviewer assigned 2026005620.

payroll: Received message. Please have Zoe confirm last four of SSN in DM so we can match records and run SSN trace. Once payroll confirms match we'll enable benefits packet in Workday and send direct deposit form.

claire-peopleops: I'll DM Zoe for SSN last4. Also drafting the email to Zoe about Day 0 checklist: 15-min IT session, upload ID (already done), confirm whether she'd like docking kit shipped to home, and remind about benefits enrollment. Draft below: 

-----
Subject: Quick checklist before your FT start (I-9, payroll, Day 0 IT)
Hi Zoe, welcome as a full-time Redwooder! A few quick items before 9/1:
1) I-9: we received your passport and marriage certificate. Please confirm you can provide the physical ID or visit an authorized agent within 3 business days of start.
2) Payroll: please DM me the last 4 of your SSN so Payroll can validate records and enable benefits.
3) IT: we scheduled a 15-minute remote session 8/31 10:00am PT to audit and enroll your contractor laptop. If you'd prefer a fresh laptop, reply and we will prepare one but it will be held until BG + SSN verification finishes.
4) Shipping: confirm whether you'd like the docking kit shipped to your home address.
5) Benefits: you must enroll within 30 days of your start; we'll enable the enrollment link after payroll validates SSN.
Thanks  Claire (People Ops)
-----

claire-peopleops: Also note: because she was a contractor, compensation setup requires job change form in Workday; Hiring Manager please approve. @dmitri-recruiter can you ping the manager?

dmitri-recruiter: Pinged manager and asked for quick approval. Manager responded: approves and prefers Zoe to start doing team syncs on Day 1.

it-ops: Confirmed IT slot 8/31 10:00am PT. We'll push enterprise MDM profile and confirm encryption. If we spot issues, we'll recommend swapping to FT laptop (we'll pre-stage and mark HOLD-ON-BG).

bg-check-bot: Final manual review complete 2026005780. Status: cleared. Name-change doc accepted.

payroll: SSN trace matched 2026005800. Payroll record updated and benefits packet enabled in Workday. Zoe will receive benefits link via email momentarily.

newhire-zoe: Got it, thanks! I confirmed last4 in DM 2026005830. Docking kit yes please, ship to home. Happy to keep contractor laptop for Day 1. See you on 8/31 for the IT session.

it-ops: Docking kit queued for shipment, signature not required. Full laptop held until final provisioning (but not needed).

claire-peopleops: All set  BG & SSN cleared, IT session scheduled, docking kit shipping. I'll update Workday and mark onboarding checklist as in-progress. Thanks team :raised_hands:
